name: fvm
description: Flutter Version Management: A simple CLI to manage Flutter SDK versions.

issues.title: [BUG] Version 3.0 broke shell completion and is less readable
[BUG] Android Studio cannot change the project's Flutter SDK path
[Enhancement] Maintain project reference to cache versions after switch
[Feature Request] Use the flutter version defined in pubspec.yaml when running `fvm install`
[BUG] `fvm use` makes unrelated changes to settings.json.

latest_release.name: fvm 4.3.2
latest_release.body:
* fix: preserve live command input/output, exit status, and Ctrl+C cleanup when falling back to the system PATH without a project or global SDK selection (#1080)
* chore: migrate FVM repository, release metadata fallback, and installer references to `btwld/fvm` (#1078)

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/btwld/fvm/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#432) for changes in earlier releases.
